patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Son) She's a diabetic and she's been getting more and more out of it over a week — so sleepy, so thirsty, peeing constantly. Her skin looks all dried up. Now she barely responds.
presentation.triageNote: 80-year-old female with diabetes and a week of increasing thirst and urination. She is profoundly dehydrated with markedly elevated glucose and has become progressively sleepy; she now responds only briefly to stimulation.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 1 is appropriate because profound dehydration with severely depressed responsiveness requires immediate significant fluid resuscitation and close airway and perfusion support.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This older adult with diabetes has prolonged osmotic symptoms, extreme dehydration, marked hyperglycemia, and now responds only briefly to stimulation.
clinical.acuityReason: Severely altered consciousness and major volume depletion indicate unstable perfusion and require immediate resuscitation.
expectedResources: Immediate IV access and significant fluid resuscitation
Bedside glucose, blood gas, osmolality, electrolytes, and renal testing
Careful insulin and electrolyte treatment after initial fluids
keyFindings: One week of thirst and frequent urination
teachingPoints: Fluid replacement is the initial priority in profound hyperosmolar dehydration.
Sodium, potassium, osmolality, renal function, and neurologic status require careful serial monitoring.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate resuscitation and controlled metabolic correction would require intensive monitored admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 80-year-old woman, frail and dehydrated, slumped drowsily on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped and barely responsive. Expression: drowsy with sunken features. Clearly visible: sunken, drowsy features and dry cracked lips. No text, no logos.
